What data leaves your app
ask the assistant, and is any of it personal information?
  • the Publishable key is in the page on purpose; the Secret key is nowhere
  • row-level security is on, and I can read my policy out loud
  • everything a person types now lives on another company’s servers, in a Region I chose
  • no personal information I do not need: not a real address, not a phone number, not somebody else’s data (APPI)
  • the free plan keeps no backups, so nothing here is safe from me deleting it
  • when I paste an error message into the assistant, the row inside it goes too
